title: ceramic french onion bowls with handles
text: ceramic french onion bowls with handles. I just threw these in the dishwasher and they look beautiful.  I chose the "gray" and it's a very faint grey, speckledly a little.  Maybe not quite as dark as the photos show - but I love just the way they are. Very nice.  You get a set of 4.  They were very well packed and arrived in great condition along with other things I had purchased. They are a good weight and the handles seem and feel sturdy.  I have not baked in them yet, but I think they will do well.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. product_metadata.title: KOOV French Onion Soup Bowls With Handles Microwave Safe, 15 Oz Ceramic Soup Crocks for Oatmeal, Cereal, Stew, dessert, Reactive Glaze Set of 4 (Nebula Blue)
features: 【GOOD DESIGN FOR DAILY USE】: This Porcelain onion soup bowl comes with a side handle for safety, comfort and using convenience. 15 Ounce capacity is also perfect for one person to enjoy hot and cold soup, oatmeal, cereal, chowders, stew, Chili, dessert etc.

【REACTIVE GLAZED COLOR】: The KOOV mini soup bowls feature unique reactive glazed color for enjoyable dining time. Remarkable display can be a charming decoration even an artwork in your dining table and kitchen.

【HEALTHY AND DURABLE PORCELAIN】: Unlike other materials, ceramic bowls has no harmful plastics, cadmium or Lead. Never worry about harmful substance leaching into your food. Sturdy enough and chip-resistant will ensure years of use.
【CONVENIENT STACKING AND STORAGE】: Stackable design does not take up too much space in your kitchen. Set of 4 can be stacked and will not be accidentally knocked down.

【DISHWASHER SAFE AND EASY CLEANUP】: These cereal bowls microwave and dishwasher safe, also can be used in the oven and refrigerator. The smooth glaze resists sticking, makes these kitchen bowls easy to clean with dishwasher or even hand wash with soap and water.
